pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with soft, rounded vertices and low-contrast edge gradients. Spatial area of patches is maximal in the mid-flank region, decreasing significantly in size towards the posterior and ventral areas.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways forming a topological grid with primarily tri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform at approximately 4-6 pixels across the central flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency sawtooth contour along the dorsal-cranial ridge. The mane silhouette is visible as a jagged 1D edge against the desaturated background.
